shape_law: iid Y_i~Gamma(1/2,1), P_i=Y_i/sumY; exact radial Rao-Blackwellization
failure_policy: same original gamma input only: high-precision recompute suspicious shapes; stop on zero/nonfinite gamma, nonpositive/nonfinite high-precision quadratic/determinant/output, fallback limit, inconsistent checkpoint, or any exception; save minimal input; no clipping/discard/resampling/partial mean renormalization
diagnostics: identity and64-reflection point means and empirical variances
exact-corner floor per shape as a106 internal normalization/loss control
global_floor_status: finite-point per-shape minimum is an UPPER envelope of true H_orbit; never a g lower certificate
error_status: MC variability and floating-point checks only; no deterministic integration error, confidence certificate, finite-variance theorem or C6 claim
resume_policy: matching source/input only; validate completed checkpoint hashes; resume only after external interruption and separate parent decision, never after scientific failure
